title: Logix Xilinx 7-series FPGAs
description: The Xilinx 7-series FPGAs of Logix Catalog (www.openlogix.org/catalog/): its file, fpgas/xilinx.json, which maps each FPGA ID to its facts. The file's name gives the FPGAs' architecture.

propertyNames.description: "$schema", or an FPGA ID: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, such as ice40hx8k-ct256.

Fpga.description: One Xilinx 7-series FPGA: its part, its size and the names the toolchain uses for it.

part_number.description: The vendor's part number, such as ICE40HX4K-TQ144.

nextpnr_device.description: The device nextpnr-xilinx uses, such as xc7a35tcsg324-1.

yosys_arch.description: The architecture yosys synthesizes for (synth_xilinx -arch), such as xc7.

prjxray_family.description: The FPGA family's folder in the Project X-Ray database, such as artix7, spartan7 or zynq7.

jtag_idcode.description: The FPGA's JTAG ID code as openFPGALoader's --detect reports it: 0x and 8 lowercase hex digits. It identifies the chip, so FPGAs made from the same chip share it. Optional: without it, tools can't check the connected FPGA before programming over JTAG.
